failure_summary.description: Agents missed the requested answer granularity or slot: they repeated clue wording, dropped a context-supported species modifier, over-narrowed the sport, or returned the linked university instead of the territory.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already instructs agents to use the requested granularity, preserve context-supported identifying details, omit unnecessary additions, and verify the answer slot. These failures reflect not following those rules, so adding duplicate guidance is not warranted.
